## Context

Track I of the stability program (plan: `.scratch/stability-analysis/11-plan-v3.md` §2, evidence `09-complete-picture.md`, grounding `12a/12b/12c`). The defect stream's introduction-side engines, from a 120-bug mechanism-read sample (R2S1, seed 20260831): gate-runtime 20.8%, product-logic representation drift (dominant sub-mechanism of 18.3%), test isolation under ~90-worktree parallelism (15.8%); amplified by 56% of fixes adding a new mechanism. This epic ships the four introduction-reducing programs as six vertical, independently-landable child slices. Track II (loop integrity: gate runtime, store staging) is separate work and NOT in scope here.

## Approach

Each child is a vertical slice: one enforcement mechanism or measurement shipped end-to-end (implementation + tests + docs + `make lint`/CI wiring where applicable). No child consumes an artifact produced by a sibling, so children are order-independent and may run in parallel under `next-batch`. Grounding constraints honored: enforcement is deterministic and harness-neutral (make lint / Verified lane / collection-time checks — never prose or harness hooks); each mechanism added names what bounds it (the ratchet itself is the bound for the epic's own additions); patterns follow the repo's existing generated-registry and shrink-only-baseline precedents.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1 (child: MCP parity gate): a deterministic drift gate cross-checks the MCP tool surface against the library facade and fails `make lint` on divergence, with a regression test proving it fires on a seeded mismatch.
- [x] AC2 (child: mirror sweep): a committed inventory of remaining hand-maintained representation mirrors exists under reports/, and every live mirror found is either gated/generated or has a linked child/discovered_from ticket.
- [x] AC3 (child: subprocess-isolation enforcement): the unit tier fails at collection time when a subprocess-spawning test does not take its isolation root from the harness, with a test proving the check fires.
- [x] AC4 (child: cache keying): shared-mutable-state-across-workers defects of the completion-cache class are prevented by per-isolation-root keying/reset, with a regression test for the shared-temp-file pattern.
- [x] AC5 (child: mechanism ratchet): `scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py` runs in `make lint` against a committed shrink-only baseline keyed per (kind, name), failing on any unjustified mechanism addition, with tests covering add/remove/justified-exception paths.
- [x] AC6 (child: upstream measurement): the three measurement reads (rework vs change size/files-touched; 20 CI-at-landing regressions; environment failures) are published under reports/ with per-case tables, and the size-rule enforcement decision is recorded either way.
- [x] AC7 (documentation): each shipped gate/check is documented where its siblings are (docs/ + the check script's --help), and docs drift gates stay green.

Program-level exit metrics (scoreboard, not close criteria): per-class bug counts at zero for 30 days per gated mirror / isolation class; additive-fix share ≤30% sustained.

## File impact scope

Container epic — no direct code; see children's file impacts.
